report.summary:
Target: code, scope S, focus "how is the analyze framework structured". The four upstream outputs (`modules`, `module-tree`, `entrypoints`, `functional-surface`) describe `src/analyze` in the repo `/Users/subhagho/work/projects/insors/insrc` as 37 modules: 21 source modules and 16 test/fixture modules. The source is split into eight sub-packages plus a small root: `classifier`, `context`, `explore`, `planner` (with `planner/templates/{code,data,docs,generic,infra}`), `executor`, `runtimes` (with `runtimes/{code,data,docs,generic,infra,shared}`), `orchestrator` and `summariser`.

The structure is a staged pipeline. `orchestrator` is the top: nothing but its own tests imports it, and it imports `classifier`, `context`, `planner`, `executor` and `runtimes/shared`, with `runAnalyze` as the run-level function. `context` is the hub that almost every other package imports; it holds scope resolution, the shaper driver, decomposer, synthesizer, provider/role routing, bundle schema and cache. `explore` holds 20 `run*` exploration runners behind `executePlan` / `stepPlan`. `planner` and `executor` are each paired with a registry: planner templates and template runtimes, both split into the same five target families.

The analysis is lossy in three ways. `functional-surface` covered only `src/analyze/summariser`. `entrypoints` is a flat list of exported functions and classes with no call edges, so stage ordering is inferred from import edges and names, not observed. No upstream output covers types or interfaces.

findings.title: Module layout: eight sub-packages plus a small root, 37 modules in total
findings.detail:
Per `modules`, `src/analyze` has 37 modules, 21 source and 16 test/fixture. Source modules and file counts:

- `src/analyze` (root): 5 files. Per `entrypoints` these include `completeness.ts`, `docs-retrieval.ts` and `item-length.ts`.
- `src/analyze/classifier`: 6
- `src/analyze/context`: 17
- `src/analyze/explore`: 27 (the largest source module)
- `src/analyze/planner`: 9, plus `planner/templates`: 3, plus one file each in `planner/templates/{code,data,docs,generic,infra}`
- `src/analyze/executor`: 6
- `src/analyze/runtimes`: 1, plus `runtimes/code`: 8, `runtimes/data`: 7, `runtimes/docs`: 6, `runtimes/generic`: 2, `runtimes/infra`: 10, `runtimes/shared`: 4
- `src/analyze/orchestrator`: 5
- `src/analyze/summariser`: 3

Every source package except `planner/templates/*` has a sibling `__tests__` module. The heaviest are `context/__tests__` (41 files) and `explore/__tests__` (16 files). `context/__tests__/fixtures` (1 file, exporting `setupFixtures` / `setupFixturesAt` / `teardownFixtures` per `entrypoints`) is also imported by `orchestrator/__tests__` per `module-tree`.

findings.title: Orchestrator is the top of the pipeline; `runAnalyze` is the run-level function
findings.detail:
Per `module-tree`, `src/analyze/orchestrator` imports `classifier` (3), `context` (5), `executor` (3), `planner` (2), `runtimes/shared` (1) and the root (2). Only `orchestrator/__tests__` imports it, so it sits at the top of the dependency graph.

Per `entrypoints` it exports:

- `orchestrator/driver.ts`: `runAnalyze(args, opts): Promise<RunAnalyzeResult>`, `concludeRun`, `completeRun`, `hintedIntentBase`
- `orchestrator/persistence.ts`: `runRecordPathFor`, `readRunRecord`, `writeRunRecord`, `abandonRunRecord`, `purgeRun`, `purgeRunForTests`
- `orchestrator/live-runs.ts`: `raiseRunLive`, `lowerRunLive`, `liveRunCount`, `isRunLive`

The signatures of `concludeRun` / `completeRun` take a `PlanTreeNode`, an `ExecutorResult`, a `ClassifiedIntent` and a context `AnswerReport`. That points to the order classify, then context, then plan, then execute, then conclude. This order is inferred from signatures and import edges; no call graph was provided upstream.

findings.title: `context` is the hub package that nearly every other package imports
findings.detail:
Per `module-tree`, `src/analyze/context` is imported by `classifier` (6), `explore` (7), `executor` (2), `orchestrator` (5), `planner` (3), `runtimes/shared` (6) and `summariser` (2). It imports back into `classifier` (2), `explore` (2) and the root (5), so `context`/`classifier` and `context`/`explore` are mutually dependent pairs.

Per `entrypoints`, its 17 files cover:

- **Shaper driver** (`context/driver.ts`): `runShaper`, `runShaperToolLoop`, `prepareScope`, `resolveRepoLastIndexedAt`, `errorForPipelineCause`, `settlePipelineOutcome`, and the `Shaper*` error classes.
- **Decompose and synthesize**: `decompose` / `prepareDecompose` / `finalizeDecompose` in `context/decomposer.ts`; `synthesize` / `prepareSynthesize` / `finalizeSynthesize` in `context/synthesizer.ts`.
- **Scope**: `resolveScope`, `resolveScopeForTarget`, `freshnessPathOf`, `longestPrefixRepo`, `connectionIsRegistered` in `context/scope.ts`; `ensureNonEmptyClosure` and the `Scope*Error` classes in `context/invariants.ts`.
- **Provider and role routing**: `buildShaperProvider`, `buildSummariserProvider`, `resolveRoleProvider`, `resolveShaperKind`, `runWithSamplerContext`, `runWithRoutingContext` in `context/shaper-provider.ts`; `resolveRole`, `createRoleRouter` in `context/role-router.ts`.
- **Bundle**: `assembleMarkdown` in `context/bundle.ts`; `validateBundle`, `modelFacingBundleSchema` in `context/schema.ts`; `readBundle` / `writeBundle` / `invalidateBundle` / `isStaleByIndexer` in `context/cache.ts`.
- **Guards and helpers**: `validateAnalyzePrompts` (`context/boot-validator.ts`), `getReadOnlyTools` / `isReadOnlyShaperTool` (`context/tool-surface.ts`), `createRepoIgnoreFilter` (`context/repo-ignore-filter.ts`), `isModelCallFailure` (`context/model-failure.ts`), `assembleLiveProjectContext` (`context/live-project-context.ts`), `shaperFor` (`context/index.ts`).

findings.title: Classifier: intent classification, scope picking and validation
findings.detail:
Per `entrypoints`, `src/analyze/classifier` exports:

- `classifier/driver.ts`: `classify(args): Promise<ClassifiedIntent>`, `connectionCheckFor`, and the error classes `ClassifierLlmUnavailableError`, `ClassifierSchemaUnrecoverable`, `ClassifierValidationExhausted`, `ClassifierPromptMissingError`.
- `classifier/scope-picker.ts`: `pickScope(args): Promise<PickScopeResult>` and its `ScopePicker*` error classes.
- `classifier/schema.ts`: `validateIntentShape`, `validateIntentShapeWithErrors`.
- `classifier/validate.ts`: `validateIntentSemantics`, `isKindCompatibleWithTarget`.

Per `module-tree`, it is imported by `orchestrator` (3), `context` (2) and `runtimes/shared` (1).

findings.title: Explore: 20 exploration runners behind one plan executor
findings.detail:
Per `entrypoints`, `src/analyze/explore/executor.ts` exports `executePlan(args): Promise<ExecutedPlan>`, `stepPlan` (which accepts a `resumeState`), `getNarrowRunner`, `failedOutput`, and the test hooks `_overrideRunnerForTest` / `_getRunnersForTest`.

The runners all take `(exp: Exploration, ctx: ExplorationRunnerContext)`. There are 20, one per file:

- Graph and code: `runClassHierarchy`, `runImportGraph`, `runModuleProfile`, `runSymbolLocate`, `runUsageExample`, `runTestLocate`, `runConventionDetect`, `runConceptResolve`, `runDataModelTrace`, `runConfigTrace`, `runSearchText`
- Docs: `runDocMention`, `runDocConstraintEnumerate`, `runDocDecisionTrace`
- Data: `runDbConnectionsList`, `runDbTablesList`, `runDbTableDescribe`
- Infra: `runManifestsLocate`
- LLM-judged or open-ended: `runCapabilityReuseCheck`, `runFreeformProbe` (which takes `runShaperToolLoop` from `context/driver.ts` as its loop)

Supporting files: `explore/completeness-facts.ts`, `explore/answer-report.ts`, `explore/item-measure.ts`, `explore/lookup-failed.ts`.

Per `module-tree`, `explore` imports the root (22) and `context` (7). It is imported by `context` (2), `runtimes/code` (4), `runtimes/docs` (6) and `runtimes/shared` (2).

findings.title: Planner and executor are each paired with a registry, split into the same five families
findings.detail:
**Planner** (`src/analyze/planner`), per `entrypoints`:

- `planner/driver.ts`: `runPlanner(args): Promise<PlanTask>`, plus `PlanBuilder*` error classes and `MaxPlanDepthExceededError`.
- `planner/recursive.ts`: `runRecursivePlanner(args): Promise<PlanTreeNode>`, `countNodes`, `countPlannerTasks`, `maxDepth`.
- `planner/validate.ts`: `validatePlan(plan, catalog, opts)`; `planner/schema.ts`: shape validators; `planner/invariant-fix-hints.ts`: `invariantFixHint`, `renderFixHint`.
- `planner/render-catalog.ts`: `renderCatalog`, `renderDepthPolicy` (scope `'XS' | 'S' | 'M' | 'L' | 'XL'`).
- `planner/cache.ts`: attempt, feedback and final-plan persistence (`writeAttempt`, `writeFeedback`, `writePlanFinal`, `readPlanFinal`, `purgePlan`).
- `planner/templates/registry.ts`: `registerTemplate`, `getTemplateCatalog`, `getTemplatesForTarget`, `getTemplate`, `getAggregatorFor`.
- `planner/templates/bootstrap.ts`: `registerBuiltinTemplates`, which fans out to `registerCodeTemplates`, `registerDataTemplates`, `registerDocsTemplates`, `registerGenericTemplates`, `registerInfraTemplates`.

**Executor** (`src/analyze/executor`), per `entrypoints`:

- `executor/walker.ts`: `runExecutor(args): Promise<ExecutorResult>`.
- `executor/registry.ts`: `registerTemplateRuntime`, `getRuntime`, `listRegisteredRuntimes`.
- `executor/cache.ts`: per-task output persistence (`writeTaskOutput`, `readTaskOutput`, `purgeTaskOutput`, `purgeAllTaskOutputs`).
- `executor/plan-sources.ts`: `collectPlanSources`; `executor/types.ts`: `ExecutorRuntimeMissingError`, `ExecutorOutputShapeError`.

Per `module-tree`, `executor` imports `planner` (2) and `context` (2). Each `planner/templates/{code,data,docs,infra}` module imports `planner` (1) and `planner/templates` (2). No import edges were reported for `planner/templates/generic`.

findings.title: Runtimes: per-family template implementations registered into the executor
findings.detail:
Per `entrypoints`, `src/analyze/runtimes/bootstrap.ts` exports `registerBuiltinRuntimes`. Per `module-tree`, `runtimes` imports only `executor` (1), and every family module imports `executor` (`code` 5, `data` 5, `docs` 5, `generic` 1, `infra` 8).

Family-specific dependencies per `module-tree`:

- `runtimes/code`: imports `explore` (4).
- `runtimes/docs`: imports `explore` (6), `summariser` (4) and `runtimes/code` (1), the only cross-family edge.
- `runtimes/data` and `runtimes/infra`: import only the root and `executor`.
- `runtimes/shared`: imports `context` (6), `classifier` (1), `executor` (2), `explore` (2), `summariser` (1) and the root (3).

Exported helpers per `entrypoints`:

- `runtimes/shared/aggregator.ts`: `runAggregator(args): Promise<AggregateReport>`, `aggregateReportCompleteness`.
- `runtimes/shared/adherence.ts`: `runAdherenceCheck`.
- `runtimes/shared/task-scope.ts`: `resolveTaskScope`, `graphRepoOf`, `inAreaOf`, `docsAreaOf`, `familyOfTemplate`.
- `runtimes/code/_shared.ts`: `readScopeRef`, `compareEntitiesByLocation`, `modulePrefixOf`.
- `runtimes/data/_shared.ts`: `resolveDataScope`, `connectionWithinScope`, `requireStringParam`, `optionalStringParam`, `acquireDataPool`.
- `runtimes/infra/_shared.ts`: `readScopeRef`, `walkFiles`, `fileWalkCompleteness`, `unreadableFile`.
- `runtimes/docs/family-summarise.ts`: `countedSkip`.

`readScopeRef` is defined separately, with the same signature, in both `runtimes/code/_shared.ts` and `runtimes/infra/_shared.ts`.

findings.title: Summariser: the only module with a full functional-surface breakdown
findings.detail:
Per `functional-surface`, `src/analyze/summariser` exports three symbols:

- `summariseDoc(args: SummariseDocArgs): Promise<SummariseDocResult>` in `summariser/driver.ts`
- `DocSummariserPromptMissingError` in `summariser/driver.ts`
- `inferDocFamily(file: string): DocFamily` in `summariser/family.ts`

Internal helpers, all in `summariser/driver.ts`: `buildMessages`, `buildPlaceholder`, `sha256`, `classifyErrorCode`, `loadPromptFile`, `resolveRelativeToInsrcRoot`.

Per `module-tree`, `summariser` imports only `context` (2) and is imported by `runtimes/docs` (4) and `runtimes/shared` (1).

findings.title: Recurring conventions: prepare/finalize pairs, per-stage error classes, test seams
findings.detail:
All from the names and signatures in `entrypoints`:

- **Prepare/finalize split around the model call.** `prepareDecompose` / `finalizeDecompose`, `prepareSynthesize` / `finalizeSynthesize`, `prepareCapabilityReuseCheck` / `finalizeCapabilityReuseCheck`, `prepareDocConstraintEnumerate` / `finalizeDocConstraintEnumerate`, `prepareDocDecisionTrace` / `finalizeDocDecisionTrace`. Each sits beside a one-shot variant (`decompose`, `synthesize`, `runCapabilityReuseCheck`, and so on). With `stepPlan`'s `resumeState` and `getNarrowRunner`, this looks like a design where the model call can be made outside the function; that reading is inferred from names only.
- **Per-stage error classes with the same three suffixes.** `*LlmUnavailableError`, `*SchemaUnrecoverable` and `*PromptMissingError` exist for Classifier, ScopePicker, Decomposer, Synthesizer and PlanBuilder. The shaper has the same three plus `ShaperToolLoopExhausted`, `ShaperInvalidInputError`, `ShaperNoPlanError` and `ShaperAnswerStepFailedError`.
- **Completeness reporting runs through every layer.** The root `completeness.ts` exports `buildCompleteness`, `deriveAnswerReport`, `mergeAnswerReports`, `renderCompletenessLine`, `completenessHeadLine`. `explore/completeness-facts.ts` exports `graphCompleteness`, `textSearchCompleteness`, `carriedCompleteness`, `reachedLimit`, `vectorPassSkipped`. `runtimes/infra/_shared.ts` exports `fileWalkCompleteness`, and `runtimes/shared/aggregator.ts` exports `aggregateReportCompleteness`.
- **Underscore-prefixed test seams.** For example `_runToolLoopForTest`, `_overrideRunnerForTest`, `_resetTemplateRegistryForTests`, `_resetRuntimeBootstrapLatchForTests`, `_setDataPoolSourceForTest`, `_setTaskScopeDepsForTest`, `_setVectorPassForTest`.
- **Four separate on-disk caches.** `context/cache.ts` (bundles), `planner/cache.ts` (plan attempts, feedback, final), `executor/cache.ts` (task outputs), `orchestrator/persistence.ts` (run records).

findings.title: Coverage gaps in this analysis
findings.detail:
- **`functional-surface` covered one module only.** It reports exports and internal helpers for `src/analyze/summariser` and nothing else. For the other 20 source modules there is no exported-versus-internal breakdown.
- **`entrypoints` is a flat symbol list.** It contains exported functions and classes with file, line range and signature, but no call edges. Stage order and who-calls-whom are inferred from `module-tree` import counts and from signatures.
- **No types or interfaces.** Names such as `ClassifiedIntent`, `PlanTreeNode`, `ExecutorResult` and `AnalyzeContextBundle` appear only inside signatures; their definitions and files were not provided.
- **Some modules have no listed symbols.** `entrypoints` shows nothing from `runtimes/generic` and only helper files (`_shared.ts`, `family-summarise.ts`) for the other runtime families, so the individual template runtimes are not enumerated. The `planner/templates/*` modules show only their `register*Templates` functions.
- **Import edges are directory-level.** `module-tree` gives counts between directories, not which files or symbols are imported.
- **Repo path.** Every path upstream is under `/Users/subhagho/work/projects/insors/insrc`; that is the indexed repo this report describes.
